description: Energy systems concepts spanning sectors (buildings, transportation, power systems) and scales (cities, provinces, countries, the globe). Emissions and decarbonization, trade-offs, low-carbon technologies. Modelling for decision-making including: model design, workflow, scenario matrices; limitations, transparency, accuracy, breadth; data handling, optimization and visualization in python. Development and application of energy systems models.
preAndCorequisites:
• Complete all of the following
    • Complete 1 of:
      • CSC110 - Fundamentals of Programming I (1.5)
      • CSC111 - Fundamentals of Programming with Engineering Applications (1.5)
    • Complete 1 of:
      • CIVE295 - Building Science Fundamentals (1.5)
      • CIVE395 - Building Science Fundamentals (1.5)
    • Complete all of:
      • CIVE360 - Sustainable Transportation Systems (1.5)
